decisive_spans.text: a 6×8 mm non-solid structure on the ventricular aspect of the anterior tricuspid leaflet with a “finger-in-glove” blind-ended protrusion, internally empty with filamentous adherent elements (“garland-like”)

response.rationale: The description of the mass as a "finger-in-glove" blind-ended protrusion, internally empty with filamentous adherent elements ("garland-like") is highly characteristic of a papillary fibroelastoma. While Lambl's excrescences can have filamentous elements, the "finger-in-glove" morphology is more specific to papillary fibroelastoma. The other diagnoses are less supported by the specific imaging findings.
